name: Anime and Manga: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Anime and Manga look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, anime key visual, thin clean line art, large detailed eyes with layered highlights, hair drawn as bold separate clumps, hard-edged cel shading with one shadow tone, saturated flat colour, crisp rim light, painted sky gradients
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, western cartoon, heavy outlines, extra fingers, blurry, text, watermark
